title: Block Towers

serves.summary: The learner builds block towers that are a number of times as tall as another tower, or a number of blocks taller, finds the tower that fits 5 times into a tall one, and names how many times as tall one tower is, which shows multiplicative comparison and how it differs from "more than".

request.objective: Interpret and build multiplicative comparisons ("3 times as tall as") and tell them apart from additive comparisons ("3 more than"), including finding the unknown factor or the smaller quantity (4.OA.A.1-2).

problems.goal: Your tower is 12 blocks: three of Ana's towers stacked.
